msItem.colophon: The colophon gives the date on which the original manuscript, from which this text was copied, was produced: Between 1st Miyāzyā (= 8th April 1705) and 9th Naḥase, the 24th year of the reign of King ʾIyāsu I (= 12th August 1705). It is similar to the colophon attested in Rome, Biblioteca dell’Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei, Conti Rossini 83. Cf.
